behaviour: Inputs frozen under s3://<bucket>/render/<job>/<render key>/in/ (ready.json last, idempotent per key)
Attempt record saved before RunTask; client token = job-key-attempt; unanswered calls re-asked with the same token; AWS refusals count as failed attempts
Attempts 1-2 FARGATE_SPOT, last attempt FARGATE; after video_render_attempts (3) the episode renders on the host (always produced)
Task syncs scene segments, alignment, layout and review frames to out/ every 15 s and on SIGTERM; next task resumes; manifest.json written last
Status errors wait (10 consecutive -> attempt abandoned); STOPPING/DEPROVISIONING wait for the exit code; exit 0 collects and verifies checksums
Task exits itself after VIDEO_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MINUTES (90); worker StopTasks after 100 minutes
Chromium gets --disable-dev-shm-usage in the render image (Fargate /dev/shm cannot be resized); alignment threads configurable (8 in the task, 2 on the host)
